subject: EnterpriseCorp - stakeholder map, procurement steps & SLA exception
summary: Post-discovery follow-up to map stakeholders and request internal approval for a buying-process exception (discount + SLA). External contacts provided procurement/legal/security leads; internal provisional approvals requested to expedite a fast-track procurement path.
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sjenkins@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 10, 2026 at 3:02 PM PDT
Subject: EnterpriseCorp - stakeholder map, procurement steps & SLA exception

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on the use case and key decision criteria. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

Attendees: Sam Jenkins (you), Nina Patel (Legal), Jorge Martinez (Procurement, introduced on call), Priya Rao (Security), and me. 

Decision criteria you highlighted:
- Production latency (95th percentile) and predictable LLM cost per 1M tokens
- Data security / SOC2 evidence and network isolation options
- SLA for uptime / response time for critical endpoints

Open asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and final sign-off owner (you mentioned Product + CFO involvement)?
2) Please share the procurement and legal contacts (email/phone) so we can loop them into contracting and security q’s.
3) You mentioned a potential need for a procurement exception around SLA/termination terms. If you can share what specifically your procurement/legal need (e.g., 99.9% SLA or indemnity changes), we can start an internal approvals thread to fast-track.

Attached: preliminary pricing proposal and a draft SLA exception form so you can see what we typically request.

If procurement can do a ~30 day review we should be fine; if they need 60–90 days we should discuss fast-track options. Happy to jump on another quick call with your procurement/legal next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf, SLA-exception-form.docx
From: Sam Jenkins <sjenkins@enterprisecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Jun 10, 2026 at 6:40 PM EDT
Subject: Re: EnterpriseCorp - stakeholder map, procurement steps & SLA exception

Marissa,

Thanks for the summary — that matches our discussion. Quick answers:
- Economic buyer / final sign-off: Sarah Liu, CFO (I will confirm exact email but I own the recommendation).
- Procurement lead: Jorge Martinez <jmartinez@enterprisecorp.com> (billing/PO workflows).
- Legal: Nina Patel <npatel@enterprisecorp.com>.
- Security: Priya Rao <priya.rao@enterprisecorp.com> for the questionnaire + network controls.

Typical procurement timeline is ~60–90 days, but Sarah can approve exceptions for strategic purchases if we can get a clear business case and a clean proposed contract/SLA. For the SLA ask: procurement will want to see the exact uptime target and credits language. They sometimes require additional indemnities for critical infra; legal will redline.

I can introduce Jorge and Nina on an email thread if you send the proposal + any standard security attestations. We are aiming for a Q3 launch; if Redwood can provide a 15–20% discount and a pragmatic SLA exception we can push to a fast-track approval.

Sam
VP Product, EnterpriseCorp
sjenkins@enterprisecorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Jun 11, 2026 at 9:15 AM PDT
Subject: FWD: EnterpriseCorp procurement contacts — request: approval for SLA/discount exception

Aditya / Rishi,

Forwarding Sam's notes — EnterpriseCorp is interested but procurement will typically take 60–90 days. They said they can fast-track with exec sign-off if we can present a concrete proposal and offer a buying-process exception.

Ask: Can I offer a provisional commercial exception to help us win this deal? Details below:
- List price ACV: $120,000/year (standard terms)
- Customer request: 20% discount, and a 99.9% uptime SLA with financial credits (they flagged this as important for platform availability)
- My recommendation: offer a 15% discount + one month of complimentary onboarding credits as a fast-track concession. For SLA, offer 99.5% SLA in contract, and a 99.9% operational target with an SLA exception form to be reviewed by Legal/Security.

If we can approve the 15% discount and the provisional SLA approach I will push procurement to fast-track and introduce Jorge/Nina to close within 4–6 weeks.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf, SLA-exception-form.docx, security-questionnaire.xlsx

Can you reply with: approve / needs changes / decline? Need a response by EOD so I can keep momentum.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Jun 11, 2026 at 10:03 AM PDT
Subject: Re: FWD: EnterpriseCorp procurement contacts — request: approval for SLA/discount exception

Marissa — I support a provisional 15% discount plus one month onboarding credits to keep the deal moving. Conditions:
- Discount and onboarding credits are contingent on signed 12-month commit and standard payment terms (Net 30).
- Legal to review and sign off on any SLA exceptions; we should not make indemnity concessions.
- If they insist on 20% or material indemnity changes, escalate to VP sales for approval.

Go ahead and offer 15% and the SLA approach you outlined; loop in finance if they push billing changes. Good work moving this forward.

— Aditya
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Jun 11, 2026 at 11:27 AM PDT
Subject: Re: FWD: EnterpriseCorp procurement contacts — request: approval for SLA/discount exception

Marissa / Aditya —
I agree to the provisional commercial terms (15% discount + one month onboarding) with the following security/legal prerequisites:
1) We need EnterpriseCorp to complete our security questionnaire (attached) and provide SOC2 report or equivalent evidence.
2) Any SLA exception must be narrowly scoped (specific endpoints and services) and include fallback language to our standard SLA for non-critical services. We cannot accept broad indemnity changes.
3) Legal needs to see the redline from Nina Patel before final sign-off — please ask them to share proposed language.

If they can provide the questionnaire and SOC2 within 7 business days and their legal redline is reasonable, I will green-light the exception. Otherwise, the exception is subject to escalation.

Rishi
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sjenkins@enterprisecorp.com>
Cc: Jorge Martinez <jmartinez@enterprisecorp.com>, Nina Patel <npatel@enterprisecorp.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 12, 2026 at 9:18 AM PDT
Subject: EnterpriseCorp - next steps & provisional offer

Hi Sam / Jorge / Nina / Priya,

Thanks for the quick responses and the procurement contacts. Per internal review, Redwood can offer the following provisional terms to support a fast-track:
- Commercial: 15% discount off list ACV ($120k list -> $102,000 net) + one month complimentary onboarding credits.
- SLA: We can offer a scoped SLA exception (target 99.9% for critical inference endpoints) subject to Legal/Security review. Formal contract will state our standard SLA (99.5%) with an appended SLA-exception addendum if both legal teams agree.

Next steps:
1) Please complete the attached security questionnaire and share SOC2 or equivalent evidence (Priya / Security).
2) Nina / Jorge: if you can send any procurement redlines, we will have Legal (Rishi) review within 3 business days.
3) If acceptable, please issue a PO referencing DEAL-2026-047 and we’ll provision the dedicated capacity and onboarding.

Link to DocuSign pricing/proposal: https://app.redwood.ai/proposals/DEAL-2026-047
Attachments: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf, SLA-exception-form.docx, security-questionnaire.xlsx

Happy to set a short call next week to finalize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
